To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) authenticity of resources is an important factor to consider when designing for scientific knowledge building, (2) authenticity is not a simple binary variable and (3) authenticity of resources influences the development of students’ epistemic complexity and their autonomy in validating information.
the use of resources of increasing authenticity leads to an increase in epistemological complexity of student-generated text.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of knowledge in a world of changing biology, with new ways of building scientific knowledge and with the influence of resources and their authenticity on the development of knowledge.
the influence of resources on the development of knowledge and strategies.
the influence of resources on the process of building scientific knowledge.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
authentic resources are not a panacea but a powerful and flexible tool to build knowledge and to engage students in the authentic process of building scientific knowledge.
the authenticity of the resource is an essential factor for building scientific knowledge.
authenticity is a major factor of success in building knowledge in information-dense environment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the more authentic resources students use, the more complex their knowledge and the more autonomous they are in their validation of knowledge, the more they are able to build their own scientific knowledge.
authenticity of resources and activities is important for the quality of the knowledge that is built by students and for their autonomy.
authenticity in the design of knowledge-building activities is a powerful tool for engaging students in scientific practices and for supporting the development of scientific thinking.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the authenticity of resources is important for students to engage in scientific knowledge building, and that the design of learning environments should be informed by the authenticity of resources.
the use of resources of increasing authenticity in building scientific knowledge is a powerful way for students to learn science.
authentic resources and activities are key to building scientific knowledge.
